name: Pope Boniface II
role: Head of the Catholic Church from 530 to 532
contribution: The first Germanic Bishop of Rome.
legacy: This person was the first Germanic Bishop of Rome

checks.lead: Pope Boniface II (Latin: Bonifatius II; died 17 October 532) was the first Germanic Bishop of Rome. He ruled the Holy See from 22 September 530 until his death on 17 October 532. Boniface died of natural causes, likely an illness or old age.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
